title: 2023 Near Mint Pokemon Safety Goggles 157/165 Reverse 151 SV2a Poke Ball
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after 2023 Pokémon Safety Goggles card is a must-have for any serious collector or fan of the Pokémon Trading Card Game. With its stunning Reverse Holo finish, this card is sure to be a showpiece in any collection.

Featuring the iconic Safety Goggles character, this Trainer-Item card is made from high-quality card stock and is a Standard size for easy storage and display. Manufactured by Nintendo in Japan, this card is part of the 151 set and is numbered 2023. It is in Japanese language and is suitable for ages 6 and up. Don't miss your chance to add this rare card to your collection!
